##: OonaCode Scoop manifest. version/url/hash are patched by packaging/scripts/bump-manifests.mjs at release time; the all-zero hash is a placeholder until the first release. Every URL here must RESOLVE (`scoop info` prints homepage + license, `scoop install` fetches url), so they all sit on the operator's own public origin — never on an unregistered domain and never on the private source repo, whose release URLs 404 for everyone and leak the repo path. The deployment serves/redirects /releases/download/* to the artefact store; OONACODE_DOWNLOAD_BASE points a bump at another public artefact host. check-manifests.mjs enforces all of this. Publish this file into the public Scoop bucket — `scoop bucket add oonacode <bucket-url>; scoop install oonacode`.
description: OonaCode — Windows-first multi-provider coding agent: the oona CLI, headless host service and local web UI (Claude Code engine, any model provider, personal remote access).
notes: oona serve       start the host service (headless) + local web UI
oona web         open the local web UI
Your data lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\OonaCode (kept across upgrades and on uninstall).
